title: adaptive-erp-menus: adaptive ERP menu personalization (simulation study and user study)
description: Code for the study on ERP menu personalization with sequential next-route predictors (LSTM, GRU, 1D-CNN, Transformer), a composite relevance score, DQN agents and a suggestion bar under role-based access control. Phase 1 (fase1_datos_sinteticos/) contains the simulator, the OE1-OE3 pipeline with the trained models and the evaluation that regenerates every table and figure of the article (python fase1_datos_sinteticos/pipeline/reproducir_articulo.py). All evidence in phase 1 comes from simulated users. Phase 2 (fase2_datos_reales/) contains the web app, database schema and scripts of the study with real participants; no participant data is included.
